head.Decidability: The load-bearing question is *what order does the work-item store impose on itself*, and after step B1 it is decidable by construction from inputs the mechanism holds. The answer at gate G1 fixed a two-field grammar: an entry in `**Depends-on:**` asserts one relation, stated by rule where the field is defined, and a citation that binds an item without ordering it sits in a second field, `**Cross-references:**`. Nothing then reads the text of a value to learn what the writer meant, which was the undecidability the first draft of this line named. The node set is decidable from `**Status:**`, which G1 also settled: `open` and `claimed` are nodes, `done` and `dropped` are not. Every figure downstream is a pure function of the node set and the edge set.
